title: きつねとつる (Kitsune to Tsuru / Fox and the Crane)
description: A fox invites a crane to dinner and serves soup on a flat plate — the crane can't eat it. The crane returns the invitation and serves food in a tall narrow jar — the fox can't eat it. A simple lesson in treating others as they would like to be treated. One of the most WK-community-recommended pieces for absolute beginners.
author: Aesop (adapted by NPO多言語多読)
